title: agrostis stolonifera subsp. coarctata
intro: Agrostis stolonifera subsp. coarctata, commonly known as a type of creeping bentgrass, is a subspecies of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Agrostis stolonifera subsp. coarctata are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and other secondary metabolites that may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
